class.name: WebSVGText
class.description: A run of text in the scriptable SVG DOM. The text is filled with [member WebSVGElement.fill]. See [WebSVGElement] for the shared properties.

members.member: The font family name. SVG [code]font-family[/code]. When empty, the renderer's default font is used.
Text anchor position, SVG [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code] (the baseline origin).
